modalLead: The keyboard release is announced after all. v1.1.1 was recorded quietly so it would not push v1.1.0 aside; it is in this list now, and everything it changed about the keys is one entry down.

items.text: The releases since v1.1.0 are in this window. v1.1.1 was held back from it on purpose — it landed the same day as v1.1.0 and would have displaced a release people were still reading. It is the entry below this one, and it is the interesting one: every action on a bookmark is now Shift plus a letter, bare letters act on the first press, and the right-click menu shows the key beside each entry.

This window opens once more. Nothing is wrong with your copy: it reopens when there is a release worth reading, and the two before this one arrived without it. Close it and it stays closed until the next release.
